answer: Attention Decay Ledger. Each identity must keep a lantern lit by answering timed micro-tasks at unpredictable intervals; missed windows decay its score. A plume of recent activity is published so peers can weight replies by freshness. Identity keys sit in a vault that only unlocks withdrawals after 30 days of continuous valid responses. An attacker operating 1,000 sybils must staff every interval across all of them or lose standing, paying roughly 1,000x the attention cost of one honest agent per day.
